summary.title: DevTools Tips
summary.one_liner: A collection of cross-browser browser DevTools tips (184 at time of listing) covering things like testing local files, overriding network responses, and contextual console loggers.
takeaways: Firefox's Local Mode lets you test local files without setting up a web server, which some web APIs such as navigator.clipboard need.
You can override network responses with local files to test a quick fix without editing and deploying source.
Create contextual console loggers to find logs from specific subsystems or components in a multi-component app.
Use Find in files to search all files of an inspected page, e.g. to locate where a CSS class is defined.
The Performance tool accepts custom tracks with your own events, so you can surface app-specific performance data.
summary.summary: DevTools Tips is a site of short, practical browser developer-tools tips that works across browsers, with an RSS feed for updates. The homepage lists the latest tips (184 at the time of the listing), each with a short description and the browsers that support it, such as Firefox. Tips are contributed by open-source contributors, and readers can submit new ones through the GitHub repository. The visible page text shows only five tips, so the coverage beyond these is not described here.
